scope: Paired SIMLOX 2017 local PMActivation.CRIT=Y/N comparison at Unit.MAXPM=0, with CAL24 initially noncritical then beyond DTIM tolerance. Determine if the critical arm bypasses the capacity limit while the CRIT=N arm remains postponed.

manual.rule: PMActivation.CRIT=N prevents a PM from becoming critical even beyond MaterielPM.DTIM; MaxPM limits noncritical PM and critical PM bypasses it. Control.ENPM remains Y in both arms.

frozen_source_delta: Derive both arms from accepted D13 MAXPM=2 input with seed1, two aircraft, three scheduled h8/h20/h32 missions, one CAL24 PM and 36-hour horizon.
Set Unit.MAXPM=0 and CAL24.DTIM=0.1 in both arms. Add one local PMActivation row for TEACH-UNIT/CAL24 with ENPM=Y, no profile, and CRIT=Y or N. PMActivation schema is copied from accepted D13.var01.
Only ProblemDescription and PMActivation.CRIT differ between arms.
acceptance_hypotheses: Both arms retain the same mission events and configured CAL24 24-hour due point; no PM physically works at hour 24 because MAXPM is zero while PM is noncritical.

At the 26.4-hour far end of the 0.1×24 deferment, CRIT=Y becomes critical and starts physical PM despite MAXPM=0; CRIT=N remains noncritical and performs no PM through hour 36. Native events and report bins, rather than the manual alone, must establish this contrast.
Both inputs roundtrip populated cells, have zero converter errors, usable SXOs and sealed raw evidence; report PM occupancy, mission results and terminal states reconcile.
gate: Publish only if native logs and reports prove a paired physical PM difference after the deferment boundary with otherwise identical sources, clean conversion, sealed evidence and independent read-only replay. If not, retain this immutable run as an excluded diagnostic and revise a new version; do not infer hidden PM counters.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 identity, immutable run path, 60-second targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: Two aircraft, one seed, one unit, fixed MAXPM=0 and one CALHOURS PM; no general capacity law, time-varying MAXPM profile, Control.ENPM=N comparison, GUI or cross-engine claim.
